race.label: Test gene-expression associations
race.description: Select genes using one eligible expression study, freeze that selection, then test the same biological contrast in a second study.
race.boundary: Exploratory unpaired processed microarrays. No paired, covariate-adjusted or clinical inference.

evaluate_predictions.label: Evaluate saved classification predictions
evaluate_predictions.description: Compare saved predicted classes with known labels. Include class probabilities to inspect confidence and retained coverage.
evaluate_predictions.boundary: Labeled CSV/TSV records and a JSON class/column manifest. No organism, expression files or executable models required.

train_validate.label: Train a baseline on source expression data
train_validate.description: Fit the existing binary logistic baseline using source data only; record source cross-validation separately from target scoring.
train_validate.action: Train source baseline and score target
train_validate.boundary: The baseline requires normal/tumor labels and eligible processed expression measurements. The public ER study is not approved for model transfer.

diagnose_shift.label: Compare dataset measurements
diagnose_shift.description: Compare distributions and project target measurements into a source-fitted PCA space. Outcome labels are not used.
diagnose_shift.boundary: Current intake accepts declared compatible processed expression types and biological identifiers, not arbitrary numeric tables. No accuracy or causal explanation without suitable evidence.

unsupported: Executable model files or model endpoints
Raw counts, FASTQ, single-cell and methylation inference
